comment: Box 1.2 correctly identifies newborns before civil registration, refugees, undocumented migrants and marginalised communities as populations foundational identity does not reach. These are substantially the same populations least likely to share a language with the clinician treating them. The guidance treats the identification gap structurally and thoroughly; the communication gap affecting the same people is not treated at all. Linking them would strengthen both the identity discussion and the equity principle.
